This Position reports to: Chapter Lead Your role and responsibilities: In this role, you will have the opportunity develop and enhance complete and sizable software modules in the assigned software engineering function in one or more of platform and application management. Each day, you will execute assigned design and development activities focused on building solutions in an efficient and cost-effective manner and in accordance with quality standards. You will also showcase your expertise by providing curate project schedule estimates and ensures their successful completion within the deadline. The work model for the role is: This role is contributing to the Electrification business Smart Power division in Bangalore, India. You will be mainly accountable for: Design and Develop - Active Participation in design/creation of scalable software solution, Design client/server-side components of web applications, Develop both front-end and back-end components, Develop solution targeting the cloud architecture, Coding and Implementations, Create/Maintain APIs, Develop and manage well-functioning databases and applications, Write clean, functional code for both front-end and back-end. Create and maintain Unit Test Cases and documentation, Testing and Debugging, Ensuring existing system functionality is intact and adding test cases to regression as needed., Test software to ensure responsiveness and efficiency. Troubleshoot, debug and upgrade the software solution. Collaboration and Communication, Work with other development team members, product owner to ideate solutions, Collaborate with other teams and analysts for software improvement, Write technical documentation for reference and reporting, Maintenance and Optimization, Maintenance / Updates to the applications as an ongoing activity Perform code refactoring as needed., Optimize the solutions - aligning to the enterprise standards for the security, performance, and scalability, Ensure security and data protection settings are maintained. Qualifications for the role: 4-8 years’ experience with full-Stack Development - Strong understanding of client-side (front-end) and server-side (back-end) components. Proficiency in HTML, CSS for structuring web content and styling, Strong knowledge of JavaScript and TypeScript for dynamic web interactions., Good Experience with frameworks like ReactJS, Angular or Vue.js. Familiarity with front-end frameworks and libraries (e.g., Angular, Vue.js, Bootstrap)., Experience in Agile methodologies and concepts. Back-End Development - Experience in designing and implementing high-performance web applications using:.NET (C#), ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NET Core, WCF (Windows Communication Foundation), Database and Data Storage. Knowledge of any CMS (Contentful, Strapi) (Strong plus), Knowledge of relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, Firebase Firestore). Microservices and REST Services: - Proficiency in designing and implementing microservices architecture., Experience with RESTful APIs. Azure DevOps: Strong knowledge of Azure DevOps processes., Creation and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines., Branching strategies and version control., Cloud and Containerization: - Familiarity with AKS (Azure Kubernetes Service) architecture., Understanding of containerization (Docker). Additional Advantage: - Exposure to other cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud)., Prior experience working with configurators domain. Qualifications:- Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field., Relevant certifications (e.g., Azure Fundamentals, AWS Cloud Practitioner) are a plus. More about us: ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions. Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences. Ready to make an impact? Works within a platform engineering and automation team, building and maintaining internal tooling, services, and integrations that support collaboration and operational workflows across BT. Focuses on full-stack development, spanning backend services, APIs, frontend interfaces, and integrations with enterprise systems (identity, data, and third-party platforms). Contributes to cloud-based platforms and internal developer tooling, with a strong focus on scalability, reliability, and maintainability. Designs and delivers high-quality, production-grade software used by thousands of internal users, improving efficiency and reducing manual processes. Builds robust APIs, services, and user-facing applications that enable self-service and streamline complex workflows. Drives improvements in performance, reliability, and security across critical internal systems. What You’ll Be Doing Build and maintain backend services, APIs, and user interfaces Write clean, well-tested code for production systems Design and develop scalable, reliable applications Work with other engineers to deliver features end to end Collaborate with platform, security, and business teams to solve problems Review code and support others to improve quality Debug issues and fix defects in live systems Improve performance, reliability, and system design Automate repetitive tasks and manual processes Contribute to technical design discussions and decisions Essential Skills / Experience Strong experience in full-stack development (frontend and backend) Good knowledge of at least one backend language (e.g., Python, Java, or Node.js) Experience building and using APIs Experience with modern frontend frameworks (e.g., React or similar) Ability to write clean, well-structured, and well-tested code Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail Experience working with cloud-based systems and services Understanding of version control (e.g., Git) and team-based development Ability to work with others and communicate clearly Willingness to learn and adapt to new tools and technologies Desirable Skills / Experience Experience designing scalable and reliable systems Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment Knowledge of databases (SQL or NoSQL) and data modelling Experience improving performance and fixing complex issues Understanding of security best practices in software development Experience working on internal platforms or developer tooling Familiarity Atlassian Cloud suite and Forge platform for plugin development Experience contributing to technical design decisions BT Group is the UK’s leading communications group and the holding company behind some of the country’s most recognised brands – including BT, EE, Openreach and Plusnet. Our purpose is as simple as it is ambitious: we connect for good. Our customers include consumers, small, medium and large businesses, public sector organisations and other communications providers. BT Group’s role is about setting direction, unlocking value and creating the conditions for our brands and businesses to thrive. Having come through the most capital-intensive phase of our fibre investment, our focus now is on what comes next – simplifying how we operate, using technology and AI to work smarter, and organising ourselves to serve customers better and grow sustainably. Group teams shape strategy, policy, brand, capital allocation and transformation, helping the whole organisation perform at its best. We have a singular culture that unites all our people: we are customer-first challengers, who are committed, clear and connected. These behaviours unite us as one team to deliver for our colleagues, our customers, our stakeholders and the country. Joining BT Group means working at the heart of a business that matters to the UK, with the opportunity to shape decisions, influence outcomes and help set the future course of one of the country’s most important companies. Itineris , with HQ in Belgium, is a global technology company purely focused on software and services for the energy and water industry. Itineris is the developer of UMAX, a customer information system (CIS) and ERP solution fully integrated with and leveraging the power of Microsoft’s Dynamics 365 platform. Founded in 2003 and Microsoft Dynamics Global ISV, Itineris has a sound financial base and has established an impressive track record of successful implementations. Our clients are international and regional players such as De Watergroep, Eneco, Engie, SSE, City of New York, City of Baltimore, Boston Water and Sewer Commission, City of Dallas With offices in Europe, North America and India, we count 550+ IT and utility specialists and are regularly looking for talented experts and starters to join our growing teams. Full stack Developer: You're the engineer who makes things real, turning complex data and business logic into product experiences that customers love. At Verity, you build end-to-end, you own what you ship, and you bring AI to the table. The Role in One Paragraph: You design and build the customer-facing features that make Verity's product stand out, combining a sharp eye for user experience with deep backend expertise. Using C#, Azure and AI, you turn complex data and business logic into elegant, reliable product experiences that customers rely on every day. What You’ll Do: Design and build customer-facing product features end-to-end. Develop robust backend APIs and services in C#. Build responsive, intuitive front-end interfaces. Integrate and deploy solutions on Azure cloud infrastructure. Embed AI-driven capabilities into product features. Collaborate with Product Managers and Functional Analysts to turn requirements into working software. Participate in code reviews and raise the engineering bar. Own features fully, from design to deployment. What You Bring: 5+ years of full stack development experience. Strong proficiency in C# / .NET. Hands-on experience with Azure cloud services. Solid front-end skills (React, Angular or similar). Experience integrating or building AI-powered features. Comfortable in an Agile / DevOps team. Ownership mindset — you own outcomes, not just tickets. Experience in energy or utilities domain is a plus. Tech Stack: C# / .NET. Azure. REST APIs. React / Angular. DevOps. AI Integration. Energy / Utilities domain (preferred). We offer you: A warm welcome! Enthusiastic colleagues will help you integrate and quickly feel at ease. The possibility to gain valuable experience in a fast-changing technological market. In-depth initial training, long term career development and personal growth. An attractive & competitive compensation & benefits package. Modern, spacious office in Hi-Tech city. And… a lot of ‘fun’ moments!
